source: 708 Remnant Influence
target: 708 Influentia Reliquiarum

source: Is this an ordinary mirror world?
target: An hic est mundus specularum vulgaris?

source: Lumian gazed at the dark, illusory paths around him that resembled a mosquito landing on a complicated spiderweb.
target: Lumian intuebatur vias obscuras et illusorias circa se, quae instar culicibus in telam araneam intricatam descendentibus videbantur.

source: For some reason, he felt a surge of fear, as if a colossal, warped, pitch‐black spider could crawl out from the depths of this strange land at any moment and drag him and Franca into the darkness that symbolized destruction.
target: Nam quadam ratione sensit impetum timoris, velut si aranea ingens, deformatum, et nigerrima ex profundis huius terrae insolitae quolibet momento emergere posset et eum cum Franca in obscuritatem quae exitium symbolizabat traheret.

source: “Is every illusory path connected to a mirror?” Franca’s voice suddenly echoed in Lumian’s ears, so close he could hear her breathing.
target: „Num omnis via illusoria ad speculum coniungitur?“ Vox Francae subito in auribus Lumiani resonavit, tam prope ut eius halitus audire posset.

source: Simultaneously, Lumian caught a whiff of a warm, sweet fragrance.
target: Simul, Lumian odorem calidum atque dulcem fragrantiæ percipuit.

source: His blood vessels inexplicably pulsed, and his body and mind relaxed slightly.
target: Vasa sanguinea eius inexplicabiliter pulsaverunt, et corpus atque mens ejus leviter relaxata erant.

source: At some point, Franca had moved to his side, her eyes flickering as she surveyed their surroundings.
target: Aliquando Franca ad latus eius accessit, oculis micantibus dum circumspiciebat.

source: Lumian nodded slightly.
target: Lumian leviter annuit.

source: “In theory, yes.”
target: „In theoria, ita.“

source: “No!” Franca rejected her speculation. “They might also be connected to some mysterious alternate space.”
target: „Non!“ Franca coniecturam suam reiecit. „Forsitan etiam ad spatium alternativum mysteriosum coniungi possint.“

source: “That’s right…” Lumian recalled his understanding of the mirror world.
target: „Recte…“ Lumian recordatus est suam notionem de mundo specularum.

source: He exhaled and took a step forward.
target: Exhalavit et gradum in antecessum tulit.

source: “I believe those situations should also be connected to mirrors, mirrors that belong to those mysterious alternate spaces.”
target: „Credo has casus etiam ad specula coniungi debere, specula quae ad illa spatia alternativa mysteriosa pertinent.“

source: Without waiting for Franca’s response, he pointed at the dark illusory path ahead and said,
target: Sine responsum Francae exspectans, viam obscuram et illusoriam ante se indicavit et dixit:

source: “Before understanding the mirror world’s coordinates and location, recklessly traversing this place is likely very dangerous.
target: „Priusquam coordinatas et locum mundi specularum intellegamus, temere hunc locum transire videtur valde periculosum.

source: If we’re lucky, we might only end up at the wrong mirror and have no choice but to return to the real world.
target: Si fortuna favet, fortasse solum ad speculum erratum perveniemus et nullum aliud erit nisi revertamur ad verum mundum.

source: If we’re unlucky, we’ll reach a mirror representing a dangerous place.
target: Si misere evenit, speculum perveniemus quod locum periculosum repraesentat.

source: When we leave, we’ll have to face terrifying enemies.
target: Cum discedemus, hostes terribiles obviam ire oportebit.

source: If we’re super unlucky…”
target: Si valde misere evenit…

source: At this point, Lumian paused.
target: Ad hoc, Lumian subsistit.

source: Franca squeezed to his side and asked in a soft voice, “What happens if we’re super unlucky?”
target: Franca se ad latus eius apposuit et leni voce rogavit: „Quid eveniet, si valde misere evenit?“

source: “W—we’ll vanish from this mirror world forever.
target: „Nos ex hoc mundo specularum in aeternum evanescemus.

source: We won’t be seen alive, and if we’re dead, our corpses will go missing.”
target: Non videbimur vivos; et, si mortui fuerimus, cadavera nostra abscondentur.”

source: Lumian composed himself and took another step forward.
target: Lumian se composuit et alium gradum in antecessum tulit.

source: All of a sudden, he sensed the dark, illusory path morph into a massive vortex, tugging him into its depths.
target: Subito sensit viam obscuram et illusoriam in ingentem vortex transformari, qui eum in profundum suum trahibat.

source: Franca experienced a comparable sensation, her spirituality sending her a powerful warning.
target: Franca sensum simile passus est, et spiritualitas eius validam admonitionem ei misit.

source: They both stepped back in unison, evading the absorption of the fearsome vortex.
target: Ambo simul retraxerunt, vitantes absorptionem vorticis terribilis.

source: “How treacherous,” Franca sighed.
target: „Quam insidiosa,“ suspiravit Franca.

source: “Just getting close to these illusory paths without going further can make you plummet into an unknown mirror.
target: „Solum accedere ad has vias illusorias, sine ulteriore progressu, te in speculum ignotum deicere potest.

source: Maybe we can only count on the luck of Winners in a situation like this.
target: Forsitan tantum in fortunam victorum in tali casu inniti possimus.

source: Let’s hope our destination isn’t too terrible.
target: Speremus ne meta nostra nimis terribilis sit.

source: Uh, your Magnify or Compelling Fate abilities should come in handy.”
target: Heu, facultates tuae “Magnify” aut “Compelling Fate” utilia erunt.

source: Lumian nodded.
target: Lumian annuit.

source: “I initially thought the mirror world was closely tied to the spirit world, and teleportation would work here too.
target: „Primum putavi mundum specularum arcte connexum esse cum mundo spirituum, et teleportationem hic quoque fieri posse.

source: But from what I can see, while there is a connection, it’s not strong enough to enable my teleportation.
target: Sed ex eo quod video, quamquam nexus existit, non satis validus est ut teleportationem meam permittat.

source: It’s not that I can’t teleport, but it’s way too risky.
target: Non enim quia teleportare nequim, sed quia nimis periculosum est.

source: There’s nearly a 100% chance of getting lost.
target: Fere plene certum est ut erremus.

source: “Without comprehending the abilities associated with the mirror world, I don’t suggest using this place to ambush Moran Avigny, unless we’re aided by a high-level Demoness or a high-level Apprentice.”
target: „Nisi facultates quae cum mundo specularum conexae sunt intellexerim, non suadeo hunc locum ad insidias contra Moran Avigny uti, nisi auxilio Demonessae vel discipuli gradus altissimi simus.“

source: Noticing Franca nod pensively, Lumian sighed in relief and intentionally taunted, “Have you recovered?”
target: Notans Francam pensanter annuere, Lumian leviter suspiravit et provocavit: „Recuperata esne?“

source: “Huh?”
target: „Heu?“

source: Franca was startled momentarily before her embarrassment morphed into anger.
target: Franca paulisper stupefacta est, antequam eius pudor in iram versa est.

source: “What other option do I have?”
target: „Quam aliam optionem habeo?“

source: “When I use a ritual to seek aid from the Primordial One, I’m inevitably impacted.
target: „Cum ritum ad auxilium ab Primo peto, inevitabiliter afficior.

source: Sometimes I’m lured, sometimes I’m in pain, and sometimes I’m dejected, as if I’ve temporarily developed a mental disorder.
target: Aliquando allicior, aliquando dolore experior, et aliquando deprimor, quasi morbum mentis temporarium evolverim.

source: Sometimes I go rigid for a while, as if I’ve been petrified…”
target: Aliquando per aliquod tempus rigidior fio, quasi lapide fixus sim.

source: Since officially joining the Demoness Sect, the Demoness of Black had shared extensive mysticism knowledge with Franca, particularly concerning prayers to the Primordial Demoness.
target: Ex quo sectam Demonessarum officialiter adiit, Demonessa Nigra amplam scientiam mysticam cum Franca communicavit, praesertim de precibus ad Demonessam Primordiale.

source: On such topics, the Demoness of Black explained:
target: De his rebus, Demonessa Nigra exponit:

source: As the ritual’s host, the ritual itself granted a degree of protection.
target: Ut hospes rituum, ipse ritus gradum tutelae praebebat.

source: The extent to which she was influenced by the Primordial One’s overflowing presence was quite minimal.
target: Gradus quo a praefulgente praesentia Primordialis afficiebatur, satis minimus erat.

source: Once the ritual concluded, she would recover after withstanding it for ten to twenty seconds.
target: Postquam ritus consummatus est, illa, decem ad viginti secundis tolerantibus, se reconvalescere solebat.

source: The only thing to watch out for was the desires arising from their typical reaction to being entranced by the Primordial One.
target: Unum tantum observandum erat: desideria oriunda ex consueta reactione ad fascinationem a Primo.

source: Their fading would be comparatively gradual, but what Demoness didn’t have numerous lovers?
target: Eorum evanescere, comparativē lente, eveniebat, sed qua Demonessa non multos amatores haberet?

source: There was no need to be overly concerned about this.
target: Non erat opus de hac re nimis solliciti esse.

source: The longer Franca talked, the more forceful she became, even a tad aggrieved.
target: Quo diutius Franca loquebat, eo vehementior facta est, etiam parum indignata.

source: “That’s a genuine deity. How can I possibly resist a genuine deity’s overflowing influence?
target: „Ille est verus deus. Quomodo possum resistere effusae potentiae dei veri?“

source: If I weren’t the ritual’s host, I would’ve been unable to restrain myself and would’ve unleashed my primal instincts.”
target: „Si non essem hospes rituum, me continere non potuissem et instinctus primordiales meos effuderem.“

source: Franca couldn’t suppress a chuckle at the reference to her primal nature.
target: Franca non potuit risum reprimere ob mentionem naturae suae primordialis.

source: Within the mirror world, she had consistently called the Primordial Demoness the Primordial One to prevent blasphemy.
target: In mundo specularum, illa constanter Demonessam Primordiale „Primordialis Unus“ appellabat, ne blasphemia vitaretur.

source: After pondering for a moment, Lumian replied, “Praying to a different genuine deity won’t lead to anything comparable unless someone present is blasphemous.”
target: Postquam per momentum meditatus est, Lumian respondit: „Preces ad alium deum verum orare nihil simile pariet, nisi quis inter praesentissimos sit blasphemus.“

source: “It’s the Primordial One’s fault for being in such a terrible state.” Franca had already come up with the justification.
target: „Culpa est Primi Unius quod in tam terribili statu versatur.“ Franca iam hanc explicationem excogitaverat.

source: “Don’t assume you can withstand it simply because you’re an Ascetic. If you had been there and not the ritual’s host, I would’ve witnessed your primal nature erupt.”
target: „Noli putare te id tolerare posse solum quia asceticus es. Si ibi fuisses, et non hospes rituum, tuam naturam primariam erupturam viderem.“

source: At this juncture, she appraised Lumian and grinned.
target: Ad hoc, illa Lumian aestimavit et subridens arridebat.

source: “It’s not like you didn’t react. Were you worried you couldn’t restrain yourself, so you purposely exposed me and created an awkward situation?”
target: „Non est quod non reageres. Erasne sollicitus te non posse te continere, ita me proposito exponens et rem incommodam creavisti?“

source: Subconsciously, Franca’s breathing turned labored again.
target: Subconscie, respiratio Francae rursus difficile facta est.

source: Lumian scoffed.
target: Lumian irrise deridit.

source: “When I got there, the scene’s lingering effects hadn’t fully dissipated, and a peculiar fragrance permeated the air.
target: „Cum advenissem, effectus residui scaenae nondum pleno evanuerant, et odor peculiaris per aerem diffundebatur.

source: That was a genuine deity. How could I withstand even the tiniest bit of a genuine deity’s overflowing influence?”
target: Ille erat verus deus. Quomodo possem et parvam partem effusae potentiae dei veri ferre?

source: He echoed Franca’s words.
target: Verba Francae repetivit.

source: “Really? Is it merely due to the lingering aroma?” Franca’s lake-blue eyes narrowed menacingly, as if challenged.
target: „Revera? Num solum ob odor remanens est?“ Oculi Francae, caerulei ut lacus, minaciter angustati sunt, quasi provocati.

source: The aqueous light in her eyes resurfaced, glittering like shards of sunlight.
target: Lumen aquosum in oculis eius iterum refulsit, micans ut fragmenta solis.

source: Lumian exhaled and stepped to the side, grasping Franca’s upper arm.
target: Lumian exhalavit et ad latus accessit, bracchium superiorem Francae prehendens.

source: “I’ll send you back first. Jenna is waiting for you.”
target: „Te primum remittam. Jenna te exspectat.“

source: “We’re heading back already?” Franca asked, surprised. “Won’t you explore the mirror world further and consider how to utilize this place?”
target: „Iam redeimus?“ rogavit Franca mirata. „Num mundum specularum ulterius non explorabis et considerabis quomodo hoc locum uti possis?“

source: “I have a plan.” Lumian tugged Franca away from the illusory tunnel’s spiderweb-like darkness.
target: „Consilium habeo.“ Lumian Francam a tenebris tunelis illusoriae, quae similes erant telae araneae, abstulit.

source: As they returned to the quarry cave, Franca, her focus diverted, inquired, “What plan?”
target: Dum ad speluncam fodinarum redibant, Franca, mente distracta, rogavit: „Quid consilium?“

source: While Lumian tried to activate the black mark on his right shoulder, he responded impassively, “Contract ability.”
target: Dum Lumian conabatur signum nigrum in dextro humero suo activare, respondit impassibiliter: „Contract ability.”

source: He intended to establish a contract with a Beyonder creature possessing a mirror world traversal ability to acquire the corresponding characteristics!
target: Conceperat contractum instituere cum creatura Beyonder, quae facultatem iter faciendi in mundo specularum possidet, ut proprietates correspondentes acquereret!

source: Regardless, he hadn’t determined which three abilities to contract this time. This could be one of them.
target: Attamen non decreverat quas tres facultates hoc tempore contracturus esset; una ex his esse poterat.

source: “You’re right, a contract ability…” Franca was thrilled.
target: „Recte dicis, contract ability…“ Franca laeta erat.

source: She then noticed Lumian was still motionless.
target: Tum animadvertit Lumian adhuc immotus esse.

source: Comprehending, she murmured into his ear, “Didn’t you want to teleport? Why haven’t we departed? Does your Spirit World Traversal activation always take this long, or are you enduring something?”
target: Intelligens, in aure eius susurravit: „Num teleporter ire non volebas? Cur nondum discessimus? Num activatio Spirit World Traversal semper tam diu durat, aut aliquid sustines?“

source: As Franca completed her sentence, the pair vanished from the gloomy quarry cave.
target: Dum Franca sententiam complevit, duo ex spelunca fodinarum lugubri evanuerunt.

source: That evening, in Lumian’s rented apartment, the nearly one‑meter‑long Fürth Firefish was set on the dining table.
target: Illo vespere, in apartamento Lumiani conducto, piscis Ignifer Fürth, fere unius metrorum longus, in mensa prandii positus est.

source: Ludwig used a child’s table knife to break through the charred and tough fish skin, cutting the fair fish meat into pieces.
target: Ludwig culter mensae puerilis usus est ut corium piscis, quod ustulatum et durum erat, frangeret, et carnem eius in partes secaret.

source: Lumian glanced at Franca, who had donned a light-colored hunting suit, and noticed the Demoness of Pleasure’s gaze was elusive, brimming with embarrassment.
target: Lumian aspiciebat Francam, quae vestem venatoriam leviter coloratam induta erat, et animadvertit aspectum Demonessae Voluptatis evasivum esse, pudore plenum.

source: She appeared to be lamenting: Kill me! This is too mortifying. I don’t want to live anymore!
target: Videtur lamentari: „Interfice me! Hoc nimis verecundum est. Non amplius vivere volo!“

source: Lumian, who had been feeling slightly embarrassed himself, smiled.
target: Lumian, qui ipse paulum erubuit, subridens arridebat.

source: He mouthed to Franca,
target: Labris verba ad Francam edidit,

source: “Post‑nut clarity is truly remarkable.”
target: „Claritās post ejaculatio vere praeclara est.“

source: Despite Franca’s inability to lip‑read, she still sensed Lumian’s ridicule.
target: Quamquam Francae labra legere non poterat, tamen Lumiani derisum sensit.

source: Pleasure is detrimental! Pleasure is detrimental! Irrespective of gender, when thoughts of pleasure dominate one’s mind, one will invariably engage in various actions that result in their own ruin!
target: Voluptas noxia est! Voluptas noxia est! Sine respectu generis, cum cogitationes voluptatis mentem dominent, certe quisque in variis actibus se ipsam ruinam afferre faciet!

source: How humiliating!
target: Quam humilium!

source: I don’t want to live!
target: Non vivere volo!

source: In that instant, Franca longed for a crevice in the ground to conceal herself.
target: In illo momento, Franca desideravit foveam in terra, qua se celaret.

source: Anthony, sitting silently at the dining table, glanced at Lumian, then at Franca, before looking away.
target: Antonius, silentim ad mensam prandii sedens, Lumian intuens, deinde Francam considerans, postea oculos avertit.

source: At last, Ludwig removed the inedible parts and sliced the fish fillets into three soup pots.
target: Denique, Ludwig partes inedibiles abstulit et fileta piscis in tres ollas secavit.

source: Franca sealed one of the pots with ice and stored it in her Traveler’s Bag for later use.
target: Franca unam ex ollis glacie obsignavit et in sacculo viatoris suo ad usum futurum reponit.

source: Ludwig slid the other one to Lugano and spoke in a childish tone, “Can we have fish fillet and clam cream broth tonight?”
target: Ludwig alterum in Lugano transtulit et voce puerili dixit: „Possumusne hac nocte ius filetae piscis cum cremore conchyliorum habere?“

source: “Sure,” Lugano promptly agreed.
target: „Certe,“ Lugano celeriter consentivit.

source: He made an effort to avert his gaze from Franca and Jenna, the two Demonesses, believing it was disrespectful to his boss.
target: Conatus est oculos avertire ab Franca et Jenna, duabus Demonessis, putans hoc esse inhonestum erga dominum suum.

source: From his viewpoint, these two Demonesses were probably the boss’s lovers.
target: Ex eius prospectu, hae duae Demonesses probabiliter amatrices domini erant.

source: He couldn’t help but marvel inwardly.
target: Non potuit non intus mirari.

source: As expected of the boss. He really has Demonesses as his lovers, and there are two of them!
target: Ut exspectabatur a domino. Vere Demonesses ut amatrices habet, et duae sunt!

source: Back then, Emperor Roselle only had one.
target: Tunc, Imperator Roselle tantum unam habebat.

source: After adding a generous amount of lemon juice to the pot of fish fillets, Ludwig slid them toward Lumian.
target: Postquam succum citri copiosum in ollam filetarum piscis adiecit, Ludwig ea ad Lumian transtulit.

source: His intention was evident. He required the blood of a Mid‑Sequence Beyonder of the Hunter pathway.
target: Propositum eius patens erat: sanguinem Beyonder de via "Mid‑Sequence" Venatoris requirebat.

source: “How much do you need?” Lumian inquired.
target: „Quantum tibi opus est?“ Lumian quaesivit.

source: “Enough to stir it up,” Ludwig replied, acting as if this was the bare minimum.
target: „Satis ad miscendum,“ Ludwig respondit, se gerens quasi hoc minimum esset.

source: Jenna frowned and asked, “How much does each person need to eat to gain that permanent effect?”
target: Jenna frontem contraxit et rogavit: „Quantum cuique edendum est, ut effectum illud permanentem adipiscatur?“

source: Ludwig answered innocently, “Different physiques and Sequences need different quantities. You’ll only find out when you actually eat it.”
target: Ludwig innocentissime respondit: „Diversae corporum formae et ordines varias quantitates postulant. Id solum cognosces cum id vere comedis.“

source: Lumian raised his eyebrows and poured the rest of Gardner Martin’s blood into the soup pot.
target: Lumian supercilia attollens reliquum sanguinem Gardner Martin in ollam effudit.

source: Noticing it was still insufficient, he used a ritual silver dagger to slice his hand and dripped 20 to 30 milliliters of blood into it.
target: Animadvertens id adhuc insufficere, utens rituali argenteo pugio ad manum suam incidendam, viginti ad triginta millilitras sanguinis in ollam stillavit.

source: Ludwig observed with anticipation.
target: Ludwig cum anticipatione observavit.

source: “Aren’t you concerned about corruption?” Lumian asked with a smirk.
target: „Nonne de corruptione sollicitus es?“ Lumian subridens quaesivit.

source: Ludwig shook his head. “The quantity here isn’t substantial.”
target: Ludwig caput movit: „Quantitas hic non est substantialis.“

source: Franca tried her best to act normally and remarked with amusement, “Discussing toxicity without considering dosage is just playing the rogue.”
target: Franca conata est agere morem ordinarium et, cum ioco, dixit: „De toxicitate sine consideratione dosarum disserere tantum quasi latronem agere est.“

source: “Indeed.” Ludwig concurred with Franca and stirred the fish slices in the soup with a spoon.
target: „Immo vero.“ Ludwig cum Franca consentivit et segmenta piscis in ius cochleario miscuit.

source: Gradually, the tender‑white fish soaked up the seemingly searing blood, and the fish slowly started to brown.
target: Gradatim, piscis tener et albus sanguinem, quod quasi ardens videbatur, absorbet, et piscis paulatim brunneus fieri incipit.

source: “Add some ice,” Ludwig instructed Franca and Jenna.
target: „Adde aliquid glaciei,“ Ludwig Francae et Jennae imperavit.

source: The two Demonesses rose in unison and extended their hands toward the soup pot.
target: Duae Demonessae simul surrexerunt et manus suas ad ollam ius protraxerunt.

source: Drops of white frost condensed and descended like rain, noticeably slowing the browning of the fish until it ceased.
target: Guttae nivis albae condensatae sunt et, ut pluvia descendentium, fuscationem piscium retardaverunt, donec cessaverunt.

source: Ludwig leaped off his chair and dashed into the kitchen, returning with a few silver plates. He distributed seven to eight Ice Lemon Fish fillets to each of them.
target: Ludwig de sella sua exilavit et in culinam celeriter cucurrit, rediens cum paucis lamellis argenteis. Singulis distribuit septem ad octo fileta “Ice Lemon Fish.”

source: “Is that all?” Jenna asked with a surprised smile.
target: „Estne id totum?“ Jenna risu mirato rogavit.

source: “If it’s not enough, you can have two or three more,” Ludwig replied earnestly.
target: „Si non sufficit, potestis habere duas vel tres plures,“ Ludwig sincere respondit.

source: Jenna instinctively wanted to say something, but she refrained when she saw Ludwig’s childlike demeanor.
target: Jenna instinctive aliquid dicere voluit, sed detinuit, cum Ludwig puerilem habitum videret.

source: She pointed at their plates and said, “Did you request so much of Lumian’s blood just to eat such a small portion of the fish?
target: Illis patinis indicavit et dixit: „Num tantum sanguinem Lumiani petivisti, ut tam parvam partem piscis ederes?

source: “Why not prepare less and save the remaining half of the pot for tomorrow?”
target: „Cur non parum praeparas et reliquam dimidiam partem ollae cras servas?“

source: Ludwig hugged the soup pot in front of him and shouted, “Mine!”
target: Ludwig ollam prandi coram se amplectens clamavit: „Mea est!“

source: “…” Jenna suddenly felt like a witch stealing candy from a child.
target: “…“ Jenna statim se sensit ut maga, quae dulcia a puero rapit.

source: He’s definitely abusing his power… Lumian glanced at Ludwig and shook his head in amusement.
target: Certe potestatem suam abutitur… Lumian ad Ludwig aspiciens subridens caput concussit.

source: “At least you have some sense when it comes to food.”
target: „Saltem aliquam rationem in cibis habes.“

source: With that, Lumian polished off all the Ice Lemon Fish fillets on his plate.
target: Hoc facto, Lumian omnia fileta “Ice Lemon Fish” in sua patina consumpsit.
